meta: AI makes up sources and quotes: it can give a convincing quote with a title and a link, but the article doesn't exist.

muc.title: Sources that sound real
muc.text: AI can give a quote that sounds very real, with an article title and a link, but the article doesn't exist.

muc.title: Open every link
muc.text: Step one: open every link. A dead link, or one that leads to a different article, means the source may be made up.

muc.title: Search the title and author
muc.text: Copy the exact title and author into a search box. If nothing matches, don't use that quote.

muc.title: Find the quoted passage
muc.text: A real article isn't enough. Find the exact quoted passage in the original, because AI often gets the meaning wrong.

muc.title: Check three sources
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for three sources on any topic, then check each one with the three steps above.

thu: Ask a chatbot for three sources on any topic, then check each one with the three steps above.
